I am writing to express my interest in applying for the Project Management and Data Science programme at HTW Berlin for the upcoming Winter Semester 27/28. I have carefully reviewed the requirements and details of the programme as outlined on your official website ([Doc 1]) and I believe that I meet all the necessary qualifications.

I hold a [Your Degree] from [Your University], with a focus on [Your Major]. My transcripts, including an explanation of the grading system at my previous university, are attached for your review ([Doc 2]). I have also included proof of my English language proficiency, as required by your institution ([Doc 3]).

In addition to my academic background, I bring with me one year of professional experience in [Your Field] after completing my first degree. I have provided official confirmation letters from my employers detailing the period of time worked there ([Doc 4]).

I am particularly drawn to the Project Management and Data Science programme at HTW Berlin due to its collaborative projects, workshops, and real-world business scenarios ([Doc 1]). The opportunity to work with peers from 16+ countries and the potential for industry involvement through guest lectures, company visits, and collaborative company projects is very appealing.

I am also aware of the high employability of HTW Berlin graduates, as they are repeatedly ranked among the best by personnel managers of large German companies ([Doc 1]). I am excited about the possibility of joining this esteemed group upon completion of my studies.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to further discuss my qualifications and interest in your programme.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to address your enquiry regarding the English language requirements for our Master's Programme in Project Management and Data Science.

According to the official programme page [Doc 1], the required level of English language skills is CEFR level C1 or higher. This can be demonstrated through various means, such as TOEFL (minimum score of 95 for the internet-based test), IELTS (minimum score of 7.0), PTE Academic Test (minimum score of 76), or comparable tests that provide evidence of CEFR level C1.

Additionally, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted entirely in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree, will also be recognized as meeting the English language requirement. If your country of origin uses English as its official language, no additional proof is needed.

Please note that applicants providing evidence of CEFR level B2 English language skills or lower will be ranked after those who meet the C1 requirement.

I hope this information clarifies the English language requirements for our programme. If you have any further questions or need assistance with your application, please do not hesitate to ask.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing in response to your enquiry regarding the application process for the Master's programme International Business at HTW Berlin.

Firstly, let me clarify that it is possible to apply before receiving your final transcript or degree certificate. However, if you are still in your final semester, you will need to provide a provisional transcript and register to write your final thesis [Doc 1]. Please note that the official application review will determine your eligibility based on the documented requirements [Doc 2].

Regarding the English language requirements, the programme requires proof of English language proficiency as defined by the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Accepted tests include TOEFL (minimum score: 95 internet-based), IELTS (minimum score: 7.0), PTE Academic (minimum score: 76 points), or a comparable test [Doc 2]. The results should not be more than two years old. If you have completed your Bachelor’s degree in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency [Doc 2].

As for the application fee, there is a handling fee for applications submitted via uni-assist if you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany. The application via HTW Berlin's application portal is free of charge [Doc 3]. Please note that this does not include tuition fees.

Lastly, I would like to inform you that the programme is presence study and starts in the summer semester [Doc 2]. For more information about the programme, please visit https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master.

If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us at [contact email].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Please note that the official application review will determine your eligibility based on the documented requirements [Doc 2].

Regarding the English language requirements, the programme requires proof of English language proficiency as defined by the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Accepted tests include TOEFL (minimum score: 95 internet-based), IELTS (minimum score: 7.0), PTE Academic (minimum score: 76 points), or a comparable test [Doc 2]. The results should not be more than two years old. If you have completed your Bachelor’s degree in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency [Doc 2].

As for the application fee, there is a handling fee for applications submitted via uni-assist if you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany. The application via HTW Berlin's application portal is free of charge [Doc 3]. Please note that this does not include tuition fees.

Lastly, I would like to inform you that the programme is presence study and starts in the summer semester [Doc 2]. For more information about the programme, please visit https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/master.

If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us at [contact email].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services
